thread:
maya (SRE): heads-up, getting a bunch of 504s from the gateway since 10:18 UTC. SLO probe on /v1/generate is spiking :rotating_light:
liam (oncall): seeing it too, alerts fired. digging into the grafana panel now.
maya (SRE): console shows elevated p95 and a burst of backend timeouts around 10:17–10:20. can anyone confirm if there's a deploy?
sophia (prod-eng): no deploys on prod since last night. I just checked CI/CD.
jordan (support): customer ticket r-3321 escalated — they report timeouts for hosted inference and partial billing errors when retrying. Ticket includes curl with X-Api-Key.
arjun (infra): checking infra metrics — host-level CPU on the GPU pod group is normal, but egress NAT errors jumped. might be transient networking or proxy.
alert-bot: [ALERT] SLO burn: gateway /v1/generate p99 12s (threshold 6s) — incident created INC-2103.
liam (oncall): grabbing traces: traces for the 504s show requests hitting gateway -> edge-proxy -> model-router, then dropped with outbound connection reset to model-worker pool. trace IDs: 000a1f.., 000a2b..
maya (SRE): ok add the relevant log queries pls. I'm running this in logs: `service:gateway AND path:/v1/generate AND status:504` filter by trace.
liam (oncall): query shows surge of `upstream reset` and `connection refused` from model-router at ~10:18. sample log:
```
2026-03-15T10:18:07Z gateway error: upstream reset by peer -> model-router-22
request_id=000a1f user=acct-993 code=504
```

sophia (prod-eng): model-team confirms one of the model-worker autoscale groups had a gradual rolling update that started at 10:15 due to a config tweak. shouldn't cause resets but might if health checks misaligned.
arjun (infra): I see nodes cordoned for drain, but drain timeout was long and we hit the connection limit on the pool. autoscaler started spinning up new nodes but model-router exceeded max-conns to old nodes then hit RSTs.
jordan (support): customer says retries got billed yet the calls timed out — is that expected? we need clear repro steps and if we should refund.
maya (SRE): billing side: timeouts that return 504 should not be billed for token generation, but retries that succeed will be billed. need to link ticket to billing team.
liam (oncall): immediate mitigation suggestion: enable canary fallback to smaller model-variant that uses different pool, and reduce max-conns on router to fail fast. can we flip fallback?
sophia (prod-eng): I can push a temporary routing override to route critical tenants to fallback model-legacy-1 for 30m. doing that now: `curl -XPOST https://console/api/route/override -d '{"route":"/v1/generate","variant":"model-legacy-1","ttl":1800}'`
ops-bot: deploy accepted, override applied for route /v1/generate -> model-legacy-1 (expires 30m).
liam (oncall): after override, p95 dropped to 1.2s and 504s stopped. SLO probes are recovering.
arjun (infra): follow-up: I'll increase the connection_pool_size and adjust drain timeout to 60s to avoid mid-drain resets. Also enable graceful-retry in the router so it will shadow retries instead of immediate fail.
maya (SRE): good. we need an ASR (after-action) for the drain behavior: which autoscaler job triggered the rolling update and why health-check window didn't account for in-flight connections.
sophia (prod-eng): autoscale job id: autoscaler-2119, triggered by config change to model-worker launch config. I'll open a PR to add staggered drain and increase healthcheck-grace to 90s.
jordan (support): for the customer: prepping message — we mitigated by routing to fallback and are adjusting infra. requesting billing review for any charged but failed requests.
liam (oncall): also noting a tracing gap between gateway and model-router for ~2mins where spans had no parent id — looks like router dropped propagation when it hit connection errors. File as tracing-gap in tracing team queue.
maya (SRE): add log and query snippets to the incident ticket:
```
# log query
resource.type="k8s_container" AND jsonPayload.service=="gateway" AND jsonPayload.path=="/v1/generate" AND jsonPayload.status==504
# trace pattern
trace.* attributes.status=="504" && http.client_trace.context_missing==true
```

arjun (infra): scheduled change: increase max-conns to 500, drain-timeout 60s, enable graceful-retry feature flag. Rolling update planned 11:10 UTC with canary.
sophia (prod-eng): will follow up with model infra for a postmortem and runbook updates for drain behavior.
jordan (support): customer updated: they confirm service working now. holding for billing confirmation. thanks everyone. :thumbsup:
maya (SRE): incident INC-2103 resolved, creating postmortem ticket PM-2103 and tagging tracing, infra, model, and billing.
alert-bot: [RESOLVED] INC-2103 - Gateway 504 spike (mitigated via routing override).
liam (oncall): closing thread, will link PM once created.
